name: MCP Tools
description: Installs MCP helper tools for Agentic Workspace, starting with Playwright MCP wrappers and a ready-to-use mcp.json for shared and isolated browser automation.

playwright_cdp_endpoint.description: CDP endpoint used by aw-playwright-mcp for the shared AW browser.

apps.reason: MCP Tools contributes mcp.json definitions that are discovered and merged by the MCP Gateway app.

dependencies.note: Runtime-enforced app dependency: aw-workspace installs/loads mcp-gateway before mcp-tools so the gateway can scan mcp-tools/mcp.json.
